Supplied model and controls from magnetic-chess-complete.zip. Original source headers grant CC0; owner authorizes CrispStrobe / BSD-3-Clause adaptations. The raw MPD, two raw programs and extension contract are retained here; scripts/adapt-magnetic-chess.mjs verifies their reviewed hashes. The app uses real sliding guides, a finite magnetic field, keyed motor braces and four bonded glass supports. Geometry attribution remains separate.
